summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Carry on while the operator is in a meeting.

Every sandbox third-party credential must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix and be referenced through `settings/vendor_sbx.toml` rather than an environment variable.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination, invoice-report optimization, and avatar migration work are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
CI pool: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded and must not be used. Webhook: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. PDF money formatting uses `format_money`; page heights use `_row_height(points)`.

## Ruled-out approaches
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index: doubled ingest write latency.

## Recent work
PDF renderer now retains negative lines, uses grouped currency formatting, fixes pagination, and passes `83 passed, 4 skipped`; full baseline was `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Began SQLAlchemy modernization by replacing function-based `declarative_base()` with `DeclarativeBase` in `ledgerly/models.py`.
